item.title: Re: Seeking greenlight: Tattooed hydraulic press
item.content:encoded:
I edited the greenlight a little bit

Seeking Greenlight: Yes
Page type: SCP Article

First of all sorry for my repost. I didn't get any greenlights or the amount of feedback I had hoped for. Also I'm new to the wiki so I don't know the proper channels.

The SCP is already written by me and is currently residing in my sandbox until I get enough greenlights to get the SCP reviewed.

Elevator pitch:
SCP-XXXX is a hydraulic press which from a first glance doesn’t seem that weird. It seems like just the ordinary hydraulic press located in different factories across the world. But upon further notice, you see that it contains several patches of skin with tattoos on them. To make things even weirder you notice that the skin doesn't match a specific skin tone (it differs from white to black skin tones). You come closer to the press and you're fascinated by the different tattoos displayed on its metalic frame. But then all the sudden…….

The machine transforms into a metalic cat like being with several blades coming from its body. The being moves closer at a fast speed and then all of the sudden one of its blades rips the tattooed flesh from your body with surgeon like skills. As you bleed your vision becomes blur. It gets blurrier and blurrier and just before you pass out, you see the being transform back into the hydraulic press. You see it pulvarize the flesh it took and then all the sudden your tattoo seems to appear on its metalic frame. Suddenly everything is dark and you're no more. But a part of you is now part of SCP-XXXX.

Central narrative:
A part of the SCP file is dedicated to the retrieval of SCP-XXXX. One of the researchers of SCP-XXXX interviews Agent Ford who helped to retrieve the SCP. During this interview we learn about the circumstances in which SCP-XXXX has been found and contained.
Example:
In 1988 several people went missing from a small town named Lockhart in Texas. A anonymous phone call from a women got the police to believe that the missing people were held at the Johnson & son factory in town. After some searching the officers and a foundation agent named Ford found a pile of dead bodies, their tattooed flesh ripped from their bodies. And next to it SCP-XXXX (the tattooed hydraulic press).

After the retrieval of SCP-XXXX the reader gets to read about research performed on SCP-XXXX. The reader learns about the nature of SCP-XXXX’s anomylous abilities. For example: SCP-XXXX has two modes of existence. It has its hydraulic press body which have several tattooed flesh patches on its frame, and it also has a secondary body, which is a cat like being into which the tattooed press transforms.

The research leads to several incidents and eventually to adjustments to the special containment procedures performed. While research is also starting to search for a way to use SCP-XXXX for the retrieval of other SCP's.

item.title: Re: Seeking greenlight: Tattooed hydraulic press
item.content:encoded:
First of all, thanks for the feedback. I'm new to this kind of stuff, but it helps.

Your current central narrative is simply the recovery operation rather than some development concerning the SCP.

My central narrative is about more than just the recovery. But I didn't mention those in the greenlight. A small part about the SCP file that I did write is about the retrieval of SCP-XXXX. The reader learns about the recovery during a debriefing with foundation agent Ford. Another part of the narrative is about tests performed on SCP-XXXX. In which questions get answered like: Does the SCP eat only flesh? Can we give it an alternative food source? What triggers SCP-XXXX's anomalous properties? The answers eventually lead to a special containment protocol.

This is generally written as SCP-XXXX-1, but why the -1? -1 is usually some other thing created by the SCP, like if an SCP creates an alternate reality, that would be SCP-XXXX-1. I think this would simply be SCP-XXXX. Perhaps the cat is SCP-XXXX and the hydraulic press is SCP-XXXX-1?

Thanks for the feedback. I tried stars * as a place holder for the numbers but that made my post wacky. So that is why I put the question mark in. XXXX seems more appropriate now you mention it.

+ show block
– hide block

The hydraulic press is called SCP-XXXX. It transforms into the cat when a tattooed person enters its vicinity (its vicinity being a 5 meter radius). When transformed it is called SCP-XXXX-1. The swords coming from its being has to do with its extreme predator like nature.

You mention all of these questions of mystery in your hook, but not what the answers to them are, sure you can have rhetorical questions about the basis on which your SCP works, but this shouldn't be about key aspects. Why does it take tattooed flesh? How does it power itself? Some may call it lazy writing to write these off as anomalous properties.

Some of these questions I want to be answered in the form of tests performed on SCP-XXXX. And some of these questions I want to leave to the imagination of the reader. Or is it best to just leave them out?

Thanks, I will remember that. I tried to edit the title but it didn't allow me. So I created a new post and tried to delete the previous one.

item.title: Seeking greenlight: Tattooed hydraulic press
item.content:encoded:
An old hydraulic press that rips tattooed flesh from its victims bodies. The patch of tattooed flesh than randomly grows on the press's metal frame.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlight: Yes
Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: This is my very first SCP. It appeared in one of my dreams and I have already written it as I didn’t know that a green light was necessary (my bad). But the basics are as follows:

SCP-? is a hydraulic press that transforms into a cat like being with swords coming from its entire being, named SCP-?-1
SCP-?-1 rips tattooed flesh from its prey, transforms back into SCP-? and uses its press to pulverize the flesh.
The tattooed flesh grows on a seemingly random location om SCP-?’s flesh.
Incidents and research logs will be integrated in the SCP article.

Central Narrative:
In 1988 people went missing in a small town named Lockhart in Texas. A anonymous women called the police officers and told them that the missing people were held at the Johnson & son factory. After some searching the officers and a foundation agent named Ford found a pile of dead bodies, their tattooed flesh ripped from their bodies. And next to it SCP-? (the tattooed hydraulic press). SCP-? got contained and research on SCP-?’s anomalous abilities began.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:
What makes this SCP stand out is its unique way to kill its prey and the mysteries that surround it. Why does SCP kill people with tattooed flesh? Why does the tattooed flesh appear on its frame? How does SCP-? power itself?
